newsitem.title: UK: Energy Group bids for U.S. power group - paper.
newsitem.headline: Energy Group bids for U.S. power group - paper.

text.p: British coal and electricity company Energy Group Plc, which demerged from Hanson Plc earlier this year, has made a $1.2 billion bid for U.S. power station group New England Electric Systems, the Sunday Telegraph reported.
The newspaper said Energy was one of four bidders shortlisted from 30 companies which made bids for generating assets of the U.S. firm last month.
If successful, it would be the largest inroad yet made by a British electricity company into the U.S. market, the paper said.
It said final bids on the auction were due to be submitted in June and the winner would be announced in August. Energy officials were not immediately available for comment on the report.
